summary: I read the cart completion and inventory reservation code and identified a candidate oversell path. Medusa's default locking provider (InMemoryLockingProvider) keeps locks in process memory, so with two servers sharing one database, the locks that should serialize stock checks in reserve-inventory and ensureInventoryLevels (validateQuantityAtLocation) do not coordinate across servers. Attempt 1 is a two-server race for the single SOLO unit, expected to fail no_oversell; attempt 2 is the one-server control, expected to pass. I have not seen the run results for either attempt, and I did not verify that the transaction isolation does not already prevent the double reservation, so the claim is a hypothesis, not a confirmed bug.
